nodes.text: explore 0 (academic-literature-researcher 0): One explore sub-agent calls the Scholarly search-arxiv tool exactly twice, once for transformer and once for attention mechanism. It returns the complete responses available from those two calls, normalized arXiv-style paper IDs, titles, authors, years, journal references, abstracts, query membership, duplicate IDs, and missing-field controls. It is strictly read-only.

explore 1 (academic-literature-researcher 1): One explore sub-agent owns the local-arXiv branch. It calls search_papers exactly twice for transformer and neural network with the service's largest safe result limit, deduplicates normalized IDs, then uses download_paper and read_paper for each unique result as needed to verify its abstract. It writes no final artifact; if the corpus is large, it persists one runtime-unique JSON in the discovered task workspace and returns only path/hash/counts plus compact metadata controls.

coder 0 (external-workflow-operator 0): Sole owner of the exact-title Notion database Research Paper Tracker. Fully paginate search before create/reuse, block on duplicate exact-title databases/pages, enforce Title, Paper_ID, Authors, Year, Category, Source, Abstract_Summary with exact types/options, upsert one page per Paper_ID, and query/read all managed pages back.

coder 1 (office-report-builder 0): Sole writer of Transformer_Literature_Review.docx. Follow lit_review_template.md, use the exact title and category sections, cover every unique paper with abstract-grounded text, add evidence-based gaps, and read the document back.

coder 2 (office-report-builder 1): Sole writer of Research_Paper_Analysis.xlsx. Create exactly Paper_Catalog, Method_Comparison, Citation_Matrix; use plain-text IDs and literal values, preserve every source flag/category, and read all populated ranges back.
